fieldValues.title: Remedies of one problem are related and shown together
fieldValues.move: Install remedy-to-remedy relation types (competes-with, complements, synthesised-from) and show every remedy answering a problem on that problem, competing pairs flagged, so a synthesis is a remedy derived from the ones it combines.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Does not say when a remedy has succeeded or failed; competing hypotheses can be laid out and still never tested.
fieldValues.falsifier: Problems with two or more remedies still show no relations between them after a period of use, or a competing pair is decided without anyone seeing both.
